youtube.title: Why Airplane Windows Are Round ✈️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
In 1954 two de Havilland Comet jetliners broke up in flight. Investigators traced the failures to metal fatigue, with cracks starting from stress concentrated at sharp corners of openings in the pressurised fuselage. Rounded windows spread the stress evenly, and aircraft have used them ever since.
